package.name: codex-rollout
package.description: Bounded reader for Codex native rollout records: the operational usage they report, how each turn ended, and the turn-error table that classifies turn-ending errors and their recovery.

module_boundary.reason: Has no root-internal imports; it remains in the repository module because its consumers reach it through the root-module replace, and can become its own module when they adopt a package-level replace.
